scope: offline fixed-B linearized set analysis; no SAC training
regular_uncertainty: xi_next=A xi+B q+w, w in unchanged certified W
jump_operator: xi_plus=xi_minus+delta; delta is not part of W
quantifier_interpretation: At every regular step a feasible q must keep the state in C_m for all w in W; an unpredictable instantaneous scenario-specific jump maps C_m into C_(m-1). Consecutive jumps are permitted.
linear_model_caveat: Numerical 2D polytope computation under the fixed affine model; nonlinear continuous-domain coverage is not proved here.
